moves.name:
S Collision
Course
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the weather turns sunny.
Deactivation Condition:
When the weather condition is no longer sunny.

Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. This attack’s power increases 30% when it is super effective. Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. If the remaining MP for the user’s [Name:MoveId Idx="241" ] is one or more when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by one and grants all of the following effects: Makes the weather sunny. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ]. Increases the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="3" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="4" ] [EN:Qty Ref="4" S="rank" P="ranks" ].

moves.description: Raises the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Raises the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. In addition, raises the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="4" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="5" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="5" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when the weather is sunny.

passives.name: Paldea Pride
passives.description: Powers up the physical attack moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces physical attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="5" ]%.)
